title: OpenStrata Host Inventory
description: A persisted set of host records: the project's reviewable .strata/hosts/inventory.json and the user cache under ~/.ost/cache/host-discovery. An inventory records a past observation, so every read re-checks the installs it names before serving any of them as usable.

cached_at.description: Seconds since the Unix epoch. Cache metadata only: it deliberately takes no part in any record's identity or fingerprint, so re-running discovery on an unchanged machine still produces identical records.
